$comment: Paid content bodies served only by POST /api/content/reveal. kind -> path under the gated data root. `gatedDir` is that root (relative to frontend/, NOT under public/, so the CDN never serves it); metadata stays in public/data. Single table shared by lib/content/paths.ts and the backend reveal route. `segments` lists the request fields appended (in order) to `base` for directory kinds. `publicNames` are metadata files that stay public and are never revealed.
